refined_nucleus: A curved, armoured optical heart rate sensor lens is integrated into a smartwatch with a dynamic calibration system and machine learning-based signal processing to reduce motion artifacts caused by arm movement and muscle contractions.
new_relationship: The integration of machine learning-based signal processing with the dynamic calibration system creates a new relationship between the sensor data and the calibration system.
new_configuration: The machine learning model is trained on a dataset of photoplethysmographic signals from various exercise and physical activities to improve the accuracy of heart rate monitoring.
new_control_rule: The control logic is updated to include a machine learning-based decision-making process to detect and adapt to different types of motion artifacts.
refined_structure: The curved lens is placed on the front of the smartwatch, and the armoured surface is integrated into the lens's design. The microcontroller, sensor, and machine learning model are embedded within the smartwatch.
refined_causal_chain: Optical heart rate sensor calibration drift during exercise
Causes motion artifacts in the photoplethysmographic signal
Intervention: integrate curved lens, armoured surface, and machine learning-based signal processing
Mechanism: curved lens and armoured surface reduce motion artifacts, machine learning model improves signal processing
Effect: improved accuracy of heart rate monitoring
Response: accurate heart rate monitoring during exercise
